description: Governor's Secretariat - Annual Financial Statment and Revenue - Expenditure Estimates of Sabaragamuwa Province
categorisation: This gazette notification deals exclusively with government structural and administrative changes related to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council's financial operations. It grants permission for expenditure, authorizes loans, and makes financial provisions for the provincial council's services during a specific period. The content focuses on administrative functions, budgetary allocations, and financial procedures without naming any specific individuals or detailing their personal responsibilities. This fits the definition of Organisational Gazettes (Type 1) as it concerns government structural/administrative changes without naming specific people.
